thesis: Upstream oil: a brokerage note says ONGC's valuation implies about 62 USD Brent versus a 75 USD assumption; Brent spiked on West Asia attacks (late Nov 2026). Intraday long when crude is firm and ONGC holds its opening range.
invalidation: Invalid if Brent falls back toward 85 USD, or windfall tax or subsidy-sharing news appears.

fields.name: regime

fields.name: direction
